enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +14: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Quality Potency +26: Passive: +26 Quality bonus to each Spell Power.
Light Absorption +23%: Passive: 23% Enhancement Bonus to Light Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
